title: TDHA: high-frequency waveform recognition
aggregation: Saved explicit-denominator summary; AP/Recall use positive-supported records, OFF FPR includes absent-device records.
limitations: Controlled recordings and previously exposed scripts; not cross-house deployment.
Ranking quality and fixed-threshold recall are different properties.

saved_uncertainty.scope: Controlled, previously exposed cross-script TDHA records. Three configuration factors change together: architecture, representation and history. These are paired effect intervals, not absolute metric CIs.
